name: Converly
description:
Converly is the easiest way to send conversions to Google Ads, Meta Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, and more when someone submits a form or schedules an appointment on your site.

This plugin makes it super easy to set up. You simply say things like 'Send conversions to Google Ads when someone submits the contact form on my website' and the plugin will set up a conversion flow, give you a snippet of code to add to your site, and test that it's all set up and working.

Instead of relying on the visitor's browser to send conversions, Converly sends conversions directly to the ad platforms' servers, where ad blockers and privacy restrictions in iOS and Safari can't get in the way.

It also captures the lead's name, email, phone, click IDs, IP address, device, etc and sends it with the conversion. This gives ad platforms the data they need to match the conversion back to a real person and the original ad they clicked. Ultimately, this means you get more accurate conversion data, and your ad platform can understand what a good lead looks like for your business so it can go find more of them.

Converly supports conditional logic so you can decide exactly when a conversion fires, such as when someone submits your Quote Request form but not your Contact Support form.

Converly gives you a full debug log that shows exactly what was captured, what was sent where, and whether it arrived successfully. You can even query it through the plugin by saying something like 'Is my conversion tracking working properly' and it will query the log and respond.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Converly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Converly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.converly.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Converly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converly lists 27 MCP tools, including add_internal_traffic_rule, check_handoff_status, connect_destination, connect_trigger_source, create_flow, delete_flow, disconnect_destination, get_event_detail, get_flow, get_install_snippet, get_install_status, and get_subscription.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Converly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Converly in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Converly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Converly is developed by Converly. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
